steps.sql:
SELECT CAST(
  (CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', q.birthday) AS INTEGER) - (strftime('%m-%d', 'now') < strftime('%m-%d', q.birthday)))
  AS INTEGER
) AS age
FROM (
  SELECT DISTINCT P.player_api_id, P.birthday
  FROM Player_Attributes AS PA
  INNER JOIN Player AS P
    ON PA.player_api_id = P.player_api_id
  WHERE PA.sprint_speed >= 97
    AND CAST(strftime('%Y', PA.date) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 2013 AND 2015
) AS q
ORDER BY age;
